kb.title: How to change the color theme in STM32CubeMX2
kb.content_text:
## Introduction

To customize the interface for projects, use the options provided by STM32CubeMX2 to personalize the appearance of files. To change the default settings and apply a personal touch, follow the procedure below.

## Changing the color theme in STM32CubeMX2

With the launch of [STM32CubeMX2](https://www.st.com/content/st_com/en/stm32cubemx.html?tab=installer#stm32-software-downloads-container), a new feature allows developers to change the color theme for the integrated development environment (IDE) and the code generation tool.

Follow one of the three methods described below:

Method 1. Open STM32CubeMX2 and click **[Project] →[Preferences] → [Theme Color]**

![BMontanari_0-1769615870047.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/e41c6eeb-50fc-f660-a08f-332d2b60c1dc.png "BMontanari_0-1769615870047.png")

![BMontanari_2-1769615870072.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/d26766c6-b8d7-9d3b-0ae0-10ad7f1e97fb.png "BMontanari_2-1769615870072.png")

Method 2. Using the lower left corner gear icon, then select **[Theme]**.

![BMontanari_5-1769616117482.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/91137e7d-f142-de77-39fa-9f7fcd6e8202.png "BMontanari_5-1769616117482.png")

![BMontanari_2-1769615870072.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/d26766c6-b8d7-9d3b-0ae0-10ad7f1e97fb.png "BMontanari_2-1769615870072.png")

Method 3 Clicking on the Gear Icon, followed by **[Settings]** will also allow you to change the appearance:

![BMontanari_3-1769615870076.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/b3e520cd-7f18-1c77-1b40-4e468005aaec.png "BMontanari_3-1769615870076.png")

## End result

The interface updates to reflect the selected theme:

![BMontanari_4-1769615870083.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/227459a9-b1c7-4c67-db5c-b1f6e8d6dfd5.png "BMontanari_4-1769615870083.png")

You now have a personalized STM32CubeMX2 interface.
